note: R3.0C C6_EXPORT state. Adds ONE production capability (comparison_export_present) backed by the new authorized path renderer/js/r3-0c-comparison-export.js — the closed-allowlist gateway that turns an authoritative C5 delta-metrics result into a bounded portable envelope per contracts/r3.0c/comparison-export-contract.js. The export service does NOT compute any new value; it validates the result is service-produced (status + sign + identity), validates association/credibility, rebuilds an explicit allowlisted plain-object payload (never spreads the caller's result), applies envelope caps via the contract, then JSON.serialize → parse → re-validate the envelope for deterministic round-trip equivalence. Stale-result guard: result.identity {caseId,sessionId} must match association.{caseId,sessionId} or the export is fail-closed (CROSS_CASE_COMPARISON_UNSUPPORTED / CROSS_SESSION_COMPARISON_UNSUPPORTED). F6 governance gate preserved: phase metrics (entry/mid/exit_delta) are reported metricAvailability:false in the export until phase_boundary_contract.enabled becomes true. Blocked-result export contains only status/reasonCodes/limitations/identity/nextValidationAction — no fabricated metrics, no raw telemetry, no per-sample arrays, no exotic objects. uiAllowed / featureRegistryActivationAllowed remain false: UI lives at C7_UI, activation at C8_ACTIVATION. The three R3.0C feature IDs (case_comparison, reference_lap, corner_delta) remain availability='deferred' in renderer/js/feature-registry.js with NO rendererAdapter until C8 authorizes activation. The next checkpoint per schema.transitions is C7_UI.
